rationale: The plan fits the 60 vs 60 unpaired single-batch design with an explicit ~condition model, control as reference, normalization inside the model (median-of-ratios or TMM), BH at 0.05, and apeglm shrinkage with CIs, which directly addresses the effect-size question. Weaknesses: the effect-size thresholds are applied post hoc as tiers rather than tested (no lfcThreshold/TREAT), the voom branch wrongly implies limma shrinks LFCs, and the low-count filter is only explicit on the voom branch while the DESeq2 branch mentions filtering only in a caveat. QC has PCA and library sizes with an outlier policy but omits the sex check and any search for hidden structure, which matters in a 120-sample blood cohort with no covariates. Enrichment was not asked and its omission is defensible, though the reference treats it as warranted; the report lacks package versions.
